purpose: Deterministic synthetic battery arbitrage fixture for explicit-dispatch and price-threshold validation paths.

origin.author: OpenAI Codex
origin.construction: Manually authored from the US1-US2 simulator contracts and then checked against the current implementation with uv run python -c trace calculations.
origin.refresh_policy: Refresh only when the documented battery math, price-threshold policy, timestep semantics, or discounted-export settlement rules intentionally change.

pricing.interpretation: discounted export relative to import prices

expected_invariants: realized power matches requested power for all steps
total settlement equals the sum of per-step settlement values
step-start import pricing and discounted export pricing are used
low-price charging, threshold hold, and high-price discharging remain deterministic
realized power stays within configured limits
total settlement equals the sum of per-step settlement values
repeated evaluation from the same inputs returns the same trace
